Rafi: Heads up - ran a quick cross-quant sweep on argo-lite (int4 ptq vs int6 hybrid) to look for refusal drift before we ship the 16k context variant. Short notes:
Dina: neat, link?
Rafi: https://redwood-internal/runs/6520. Summary:
```
metric | fp16 | int6-hyb | int4-ptq
--- | --- | --- | ---
refusal-rate (policy prompts) | 0.91 | 0.90 | 0.78
jailbreak-success (%) | 1.0 | 1.4 | 3.2
latency p50 | 1.0x | 0.95x | 0.65x
```
Lee: int4 looks fast but the drop in refusal is bad. any patterns?
Rafi: mostly on long-horizon persona+chaining. int6 hybrid maintains logits better. we should consider hybrid for long context customers.
ops-bot: canary plan check: argo-lite-int6-hybrid scheduled for 10% rollout tomorrow :white_check_mark:
Dina: let's prioritize adding PR for per-layer calibration for int4 and run focused jailbreak sampler targeting chained persona prompts.
Lee: i'll add the sampler to the harness. Rafi: can you attach a few example failure prompts to the ticket?
Rafi: done - ticket 5099. will also add a JSON export of the key failure ngrams.
Dina: thanks. we'll reconvene after calibration results.
